json.rationale: You are on an unpaved road (vía sin pavimentar) arriving at a crossroads with a paved road (vía pavimentada). Vehicles on the paved road have right of preference (preferencia de paso). So you must yield (ceda el paso), and you may go once it is clear without forcing others to brake or swerve.
json.temptingWrongAnswer: Proceed because the junction looks empty and no one is coming.
json.whyWrong: An empty view does not give you priority. The excerpt gives preference to paved-road traffic over unpaved-road traffic, so you must still yield first.
